# Molten core

Type: Material | Internal ID: MoltenCore | Source: Charred Fortress | Putrid Hole | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Molten cores are a crafting material from the Ashlands.

## Availability

• Inside Putrid Hole.
• On the ground inside Charred Fortress.
• As loot from Charred chest in Charred Fortress.
• Mysterious Locations will spawn with 4.

### Building

• Portal – Stone

### Crafting

• Brimstone
